newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Road King signs JV for China expressway.
newsitem.headline: Road King signs JV for China expressway.

text.p: Road King Infrastructure Ltd said on Thursday it had signed a joint venure agreement to expand its Yulin Highway Network into Guangxi province in southern China.

Road King would invest 313.4 million renminbi for a 70 percent stake in the Yulin Highway Network, which comprises the Yulin City Ring Road and the Yulin section of the Yulin-Gongguan Highway, it said.
Road King would have a 25-year term in the joint venture, it said, adding that it had secured preferential income distribution and a five-year minimum income undertaking under the terms of agreement.
The remaing share of the joint venture was taken up by an enterprise under the supervision of the Yulin government, it said.
